provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

glosses: as far as; all the way to
patterns.usage_note: Marks how far an action reaches over a noun of place, time, or degree, covering the whole span up to that point, so the predicate is usually durative: 駅まで歩く, 五時まで待つ. Sibling lanes take the other jobs: the clause-attached range running until an event happens (雨がやむまで), the limiting まで that caps an allowance (一人二枚まで), and 〜までだ for a fallback plan (やり直すまでだ). Use までに when a one-shot event has a deadline: 五時までに来る.

examples.ruby: 今日[きょう]は夕方[ゆうがた]まで図書館[としょかん]で調[しら]べ物[もの]をする。
examples.english: I'll be doing research at the library until early evening today.

examples.ruby: 駅[えき]までなら歩[ある]いて十分[じゅっぷん]もかからない。
examples.english: As far as the station it's not even a ten-minute walk.

examples.ruby: 荷物[にもつ]は玄関[げんかん]まで運[はこ]んでおきました。
examples.english: I've carried the bags as far as the entryway for you.
